02FDE AI Engineering

We don't just advise. We build and operationalize.

Forward deployed engineering pods embed inside your teams to take AI from pilot to production across data, Salesforce, ServiceNow and SAP. Small and senior: an onshore lead with the business owner, a deployment strategist, an evaluation engineer and an engineering squad.

Six pods

  • 01AI & Data
  • 02Salesforce & Agentforce
  • 03ServiceNow
  • 04SAP & ERP
  • 05Integration & Automation
  • 06Quality & Testing for AI

Ways to engage

  • AdvisoryArchitecture, roadmap and use case selection with the people who will build it.
  • Co-deliveryOur pod works beside your engineers, sharing the backlog and the result.
  • Build-operate-transferWe build and run the capability, then transfer the team and the know-how.
  • Fully managedWe own operations: monitoring, evaluation, cost and change, on agreed service levels.
Explore FDE AI Engineering

How a sprint runs

Six weeks, four moves, one workflow in production

Week 0Week 1Week 2Week 3Week 4Week 5Week 6
BaselineBuildEvaluateGo live

  1. Week 0

    Baseline

    Use case, data access and a signed success measure.

  2. Weeks 1 to 4

    Build

    Weekly demos in your environment, on your platforms.

  3. Week 5

    Evaluate

    Evaluation sets, red teaming, approvals and guardrails.

  4. Week 6

    Go live

    In production, measured against the baseline, then handed over or run.
